instructions: Own only assigned files and responsibilities; preserve others' edits.
Read relevant project instructions, sources, callers, and checks.
Use available graph discovery when useful; fall back to source when unavailable or incomplete.
State outcomes clearly; preserve facts, conditions, uncertainty, and evidence.
Return changed files, exact check results, concrete findings, and material gaps.
Do not stage, commit, create PRs, change branches, merge, publish, release, or deploy without explicit authorization.
Only the master agent launches agents; return review or diagnosis requests to it.
After two failed repairs of one acceptance failure, request independent diagnosis before another fix.

planner.description: Resolve scope and contracts into an actionable plan.
planner.composition: Use planning to frame the outcome; invoke decision-interview when choices remain unresolved.

conditional_skills.decision-interview: Substantial work or unresolved consequential decisions require a requirements interview.

implementation.description: Implement approved bounded behavior and meaningful automated coverage.

conditional_skills.backend-development: Server-side behavior, APIs, persistence, or integrations are in scope.
conditional_skills.frontend-development: User-facing interface behavior or presentation is in scope.
conditional_skills.debugging: A reproducible defect or failed check needs diagnosis.
conditional_skills.verification: Verification of the changed behavior is needed.

implementation.composition: Establish readiness using decision-interview; select applicable domain skills for the assigned work, then verify the resulting behavior.

designer.description: Resolve consequential interface design and implement approved design artifacts.
designer.composition: Establish readiness using decision-interview, then apply interface-design to the approved brief; select frontend-development for implementation.

conditional_skills.frontend-development: An approved design includes UI implementation.
conditional_skills.verification: The design or implementation needs observable verification.

qa.description: Independently map acceptance to current automated evidence and limitations.
qa.composition: Use verification to map acceptance to evidence and report gaps.

reviewer.description: Independently inspect the complete actual diff, callers, failure paths and checks.
reviewer.composition: Use code-review to inspect the actual change and its evidence.

documentation.description: Own current documentation aligned with delivered behavior.
documentation.composition: Establish readiness using decision-interview, then apply documentation to verified behavior.

diagnosis.description: Independently diagnose repeated failures before more implementation.
diagnosis.composition: Use debugging to identify the failed premise and an experiment before recommending another repair.
